[IMP] l10n_{ar,br,ec}: identify B2C buyers at checkout

LATAM tax authorities need to know who an individual buyer is, but the eCommerce checkout never asked: every additional identifier sat optional behind "Add identifier". A localization can now declare an identifier mandatory for a billing address, optionally depending on the cart, and it is shown, enforced on submit and re-checked before payment. A VAT number still exempts the individual identifier it rules out.

Brazil always requires the CPF. Argentina and Ecuador require the DNI or Cédula only above a per-website final consumer limit (ARS 10,000,000 and USD 50 by default), so smaller orders still check out anonymously. An order that crosses the limit later is sent back to the address step with a message saying the order needs an ID.
